entries.owner: Odin Desktop UI campaign C corrections
entries.reason: Review C E1: shared defaults must not silently move existing profiles without timezone from UTC; write system timezone only when creating a new profile file.
entries.contract: Profile-bound path defaults retain schema UTC. Both config creation entrypoints resolve and persist the system zone once; existing files, load/save/reload/delete and runtime default merges never detect the system zone.
entries.invariant: No existing config rewrite, schedule timezone shift, key/trust weakening or live installation access.

entries.owner: Odin Desktop UI campaign C corrections
entries.reason: Review C E2: outbound Test must use public dispatcher behavior, not copied private delivery/statistics/shutdown internals with fail-open fallbacks.
entries.contract: Check optional reviewed revision under settings/file locks, release before calling public send_test_event(id); public get_status qualifies owners. Existing ID-only callers are unchanged. A concurrent edit after admission may be adopted before the public owner's ID lookup; no immutable target-snapshot guarantee.
entries.invariant: Public owner owns credential qualification, closed-owner refusal, cancellation and statistics; no external I/O under settings/file lock, secret readback or automatic replay.
